column1: # Constraint rules for the class of an omitted subject (Z): speaker, addressee, third, generic, none. A clause
# with a subject argument is "overt". Otherwise the most specific row whose atoms all hold gives the class; no
# row, no class (Default). when atoms: force (decl q imp prohib prop excl request), mod (modality names), polite
# (plain desu-masu sonkei kenjo gozaimasu), bene (give-out give-in receive), voice, pol, tense, link, aspect, jreg,
# sp (Q inside a quote or dialogue, N narration), lemma (the predicate's lemma), person (the class of a topic
# person word: speaker addressee third), obj, dat; ! negates; atoms joined by &.

column5: a command, request or prohibition is addressed to the listener
しよう/しましょう: the speaker (with the listener)
たい and the volitional in a spoken statement: the speaker (in narration the subject is whoever the narration follows)
humble verbs (参る, 申す, いたす): the speaker
a respectful verb in a question: the listener
a respectful verb in speech is never the speaker; the listener by default
くれる/くださる: the giver is not the speaker
～てくれる? / ～てください: the listener gives
a topic person word (俺は) names the subject
a topic person word (お前は) names the subject
a topic name or person word names the subject
